request: Retry of non-executed DebugAI MCP preflight after observed Host SHA mismatch; read-only

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'HOST_SHA='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_BRANCH='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai branch --show-current
printf 'DEBUGAI_DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l
for f in mcp/server.mjs bin/debugai-mcp.mjs mcp/tests/mcp-stdio.test.mjs; do
  if test -f "/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/$f"; then printf 'MCP_FILE_PRESENT=%s\n' "$f"; else printf 'MCP_FILE_MISSING=%s\n' "$f"; fi
done
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'NODE_VERSION='; node --version; else printf 'NODE=NOT_FOUND\n'; fi
if test -d /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server; then printf 'MCP_SERVER_PACKAGE=INSTALLED\n'; else printf 'MCP_SERVER_PACKAGE=ABSENT\n'; fi
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf 'DEBUGAI_HEALTH_HTTP='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health || true
fi
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker inspect --format 'DEBUGAI_CONTAINER_STATUS={{.State.Status}} IMAGE={{.Image}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1 2>/dev/null || printf 'DEBUGAI_CONTAINER=NOT_READABLE\n'
fi
